Name: Alya's Dreamy Hill Farm
Author: AlyaLyalya
Description:
[size=3][center][/center][/size][left][size=3]This is my first attempt to  make a farm map. If you encounter anything weird, let me know and I'll try to figure out how to help you and fix it. I made this mostly based on my own preferences. I wanted an easier start and to focus on other aspects of the game, like socializing and just wandering around.[/size]

[size=3]So, this small map features: 
[b]Different Starter Gifts[/b] - choose before starting new save file! 
[spoiler] 
"Default"- 15 parsnip seeds;
"Farming" - Chest, 15 Quality Fertilizers, 15 Kale Seeds, 1 Apple Sapling, 1 Preserves Jar and 3 Hashbrowns ;
"Ranching" - Chest, 20 Hay, 10 Parsnip Seeds, 1 Bee House, 1 Mayonnaise Machine, 3 Hashbrowns ;
"Mining" - Chest, 1 Glowstone Ring, 5 Geodes, 5 Cherry Bombs, 1 Wood Mallet, 3 Cranberry Sauces ;
"Joja" - Chest, 5 Joja Cola,  3 Fried Eel, 1 Crystalarium, 1 Lawn Flamingo. [/spoiler][/size]
[b][size=3]SpaCave[/size][/b][size=3] - an additional mini-location with a pond to refil your energy, place for crops or casks, a respawning Fiddlehead fern, fishable cave jelly. [/size]
[i][size=3][b]ExtraCave[/b] [/size][/i][size=3]- an additional mini-location with space for crops or casks and cute pond with fishes (flounder, halibut and sea jelly).[/size]
[b][size=3]Shortcuts[/size][/b][size=3] - [u]to Secret Woods[/u], [u]Railroad[/u] (work only after the player has entered these locations at least once), and [/size][u][size=3]to Forest[/size][/u][size=3] (behind big pink tree).[/size]
[size=3][i][u]* Config Options - you can choose starter gift, to have or not Spacave, ExtraCave and the warps on your farm*[/u][/i]

[b]Farming:[/b] All tiles should be tillable!
[b]Foraging[/b]: 9 Berry Bushes, spawn areas for: vanilla seasonal flowers (on sunny days), mushrooms (after rainy days); 4 respawning stumps, a little quarry. Some digging spots that can give you something usefull. So don't miss them! Also there is a treasure buried in a hidden place.[i]If you don't want respawns and digging spots just delite "(FTM) Alya'sDreamyHillFarm" folder in your mods folder after unpacking this mod. [/i]
[b]Ranching:[/b] start with the blue grass! 
[b]Fishing[/b]: you can catch a mountain, river and woods fish on the farm (look at the image), also there are some stuff you might catch (like lucky ring, pearl, holy blade and other).  [i]Note: you will catch a sunfish first at all fishing areas, i don't know how to avoid it.[/i]﻿
It's [b]safe to pass out [/b]on your farm, because it's... you know... yours.﻿
There are some[b] lights[/b] on unmovable places. So it's not that dark and scary at the beginning.
[b]
Compatibility:
[/b]Recolors - should work fine.
SVE - I don't play with it but warps to Woods, Forest and Railroad should work, also in SVE mod config you can choose 'Grandpa's Shed' option that moves the warp point off the farm and custom coorditanes for Enchanted Grove Warp (i suggest x 41 y 15 - next to farm warp totem, but you can choose whatever). Warps might not work good with the mods that changing those locations.
Minecarts - this map is shorter then standard vanilla farms and some mods that add minecart on the farm might cause an issue with black void after the right edge of the farm map. If you have it, try choose custom option in those mods if possible. I know that [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21859](CP) More Minecarts[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881 ]Integrated Minecarts - A Minecart Expansion[/url]﻿ have this option. So in configs of those mods choose (x 44 y 14 or whatever you want).
Well, that was really hard for me to do cause i'm  a novice in this but i had fun and i was really proud to start new save with my own map, haha. I really hope that someone of you would have fun to play on this map. I wish you all the best. Sorry if i made a lot of english mistakes, i tried not to :)
